assumptions: The paper does not specify instruments; included RHS regressors are treated as their own instruments, so the linear moments are exactly identified and the coefficient solution equals OLS.
ivreg2 robust panel HAC uses Bartlett bandwidth 4, which the installed help defines as three nonzero lags; xtset panel/time ordering is GVKEY and FYEAR.

Non-USD accounting inputs use positive unique same-date Xpressfeed GBP cross-rates; missing rates leave the affected support measures unavailable. Supporting PROC REG residuals require full model rank (rank computed as complete-case N minus OUTEST residual degrees of freedom).
BM and SIZE use company-level CRSP market equity only for a unique effective CCM/CRSP PERMCO mapping with complete common-issue quotes near the valuation date; unresolved values remain missing.
All RHS controls must be observed for each baseline fit; missing analyst/institutional data remain missing.

limitations: The source leaves the instrument set, GMM weighting details, and panel covariance ordering unspecified. The fitted regressors are used as instruments; in this exactly identified linear equation the OLS coefficient solution with panel HAC is equivalent to those moments.

Local eligible samples differ from the published counts and complete-case regression samples are smaller because source analyst and institutional ownership observations are missing. The exact source of the published-count discrepancy is unresolved; no source-vintage attribution is asserted.

Data mappings, annual volatility coverage, currency translation, company-level market equity, and historical links are best effort from local Compustat, CRSP, IBES, holdings, and Fama–French sources; see design.md and review.md.
Non-USD accounting amounts require positive unique same-date Xpressfeed GBP-to-source and GBP-to-USD legs. Unavailable or ambiguous FX legs remain missing; no historical rates are imputed.

Company market equity sums all common issues only when the effective CCM/CRSP PERMCO mapping is unique and all active issues have valid quotes on one date within 30 days of the three-month target. Ambiguous mappings and incomplete quote sets leave MVE unavailable.

FREV2A subtracts MEDEST only for identical nonmissing IBES CURCODE values; the source paper does not state currency treatment, and 37 cross-currency pairs were identified in the bounded matched-pair diagnostic.

S34 retains the earliest FDATE at MGRNO/RDATE grain and all holdings from that vintage. SHARES is converted from FDATE to the CRSP RDATE-month share basis with CFACSHR(FDATE)/CFACSHR(RDATE month); this is a documented best-effort vintage choice because the paper does not specify the vendor or filing vintage.
